title: ListOrganizerMomentsCallableResponse
description: All moments for one scope, sorted by momentId, with what each has sent and when it runs next.

senderConnectionId.description: Programme scopes only: the organiser's active WhatsApp sender connection that new planned messages send through, or null when none is active.

plans.description: One entry per listed moment, keyed by momentId. Optional so older servers stay readable; a client without it treats every moment as planned with nothing sent.

sentCount.description: Messages sent across every dispatched run.

nextRunAtMillis.description: The earliest planned run, or null when nothing is planned.

state.description: Board state: next is the armed moment that runs soonest in this scope; sent has dispatched and has nothing planned.
